messages:
alyssa: Heads-up team 1: web4re shipping the OpenInfra benchmark next week. Need design assets ready for launch day (creative pack). List below - can @leo take visuals lead?

leo: I can. Whatb4s the final deliverable list and deadline?

alyssa: Deliverables: hero banner (web + mobile crops), three social tiles (X, LinkedIn, Mastodon), animated 30s trailer, webinar slide template, one-page sales diagram, and a downloadable benchmark PDF. Deadline: comps by Monday 10am PT. Brand + accessibility must be followed.

mike: Ib4ll supply the benchmark highlights, topline numbers, CSV of results, and a reproducible runbook snippet today. Also routing snippet for HubSpot lead form.

leo: Cool. Ib4ll prepare two visual directions: "Metric-first" (charts front-and-center) and "Product-first" (customer outcomes + illustration). Will avoid stock photos, use abstract gradients + illustrations. Using Inter and Redwood palette.

sarah: For slides include: title, quick TL;DR, methodology, latency vs cost chart, config recommendations, customer outcomes, CTA. Export PPTX (16:9) and single-slide PNGs for socials. Add speaker notes with 1-sentence prompts.

alyssa: Also need social captions variants: technical and business. Mike will draft. We need UTM pattern: utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=openinfra_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}.

mike: Draft caption examples: "See reproducible benchmark: 3x gen cost reduction + predictable p95 latency. Register for the webinar or download the full benchmark." Will tailor to LinkedIn tone as well.

leo: Export spec I'll follow: hero 2400x900 (web) + 1200x675 (social), X 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x627, Mastodon 1080x1080, trailer 1280x720 mp4 (30s). One-pager A4 PDF. All images with alt text.

figma-bot: Created file and frames: hero_metric_v1, hero_product_v1, social_x_metric, social_x_product, slide_template_v1, onepager_v1.

alyssa: Accessibility checklist - ensure text contrast >=4.5:1, headings as editable text, include alt text lines, and colorblind-safe chart palettes.

leo: Will annotate each frame with export filename and usage. Also include a version with a larger chart inset for data audiences.

mike: Attaching benchmark command we used (refine if needed):
```
run-bench --model redwood-13b --seq 2048 --batch 16 --mode realtime --region us-west-2
```

alyssa: Legal check: if we reference competitor numbers or logos, run by legal. @sarah please ping legal when comps are in.

sarah: Will ping legal and ops. Also please provide raw CSV so I can pull clean charts for slides.

leo: Plan: upload initial A/B comps to Figma by EOD tomorrow, will tag exported PNGs and a PPTX template.

alyssa: Great. After Leo uploads Ib4ll review and route to sales/comms for messaging alignment. :thumbsup:

figma-bot: Frames uploaded and ready for review in Figma file link (internal).

mike: Ib4ll drop the CSV and final copy later today.

alyssa: Thanks everyone! If blockers, DM me."
